headline: Hurun India and Avendus Wealth release the U35 list for 2026 featuring young entrepreneurs
hook: New founders make the Hurun U35 list
summary: The Avendus Wealth–Hurun India U35 List 2026 highlights ten entrepreneurs aged 31 operating across artificial intelligence, space technology, jewellery, renewable energy, and industrials. Anmol Bhansali of Goldiam International is noted as the youngest male entrepreneur on the list. Romita Mazumdar, founder of Foxtale, is recognized as the youngest woman entrepreneur. The ranking showcases emerging leadership across diverse sectors in the Indian startup and business ecosystem.
why_it_matters: Spotlights emerging entrepreneurial trends across key sectors.
